Prevention · Patient guide

Dental checkups in Gujranwala

A dental exam helps you understand the condition of your teeth and gums and plan any care you need.

Ask about an appointment →

When might I need it?

Book a routine visit even if nothing hurts. An exam is also a useful starting point for sensitivity, bleeding gums, a broken tooth, or concerns about a child's developing teeth.

What age group is it for?

Children, teens and adults can have checkups. The dentist will recommend a return interval based on your age, oral health and risk factors.

What happens at the appointment?

The dentist asks about your concerns and health history, examines your teeth and gums, and discusses any findings. X-rays may be recommended when they would help answer a specific question.

Does it hurt?

A routine exam usually involves little discomfort. Tell the dentist about sensitive areas or dental anxiety so the exam can be paced around you.

How much does it cost?

Ask reception for the current exam fee and whether X-rays, cleaning or follow-up visits are charged separately.

For current pricing and availability, ask the clinic for a quote in PKR based on your assessment.

Plan your visit

Ask the team about availability, the consultation fee, and what to bring. Wait for reception to confirm the date and time.
